concept: NAT Gateway: one per AZ for HA outbound access
tests: How to give private instances highly available outbound internet access with minimal administration.
expected: A managed NAT gateway in each AZ's public subnet, private subnet routes pointing to the NAT in their own AZ. Triggers: "outbound only", "must not be reachable from the internet", "private subnets", "high availability, low management".
why_not: An IGW in private subnets makes them public; a single NAT instance — a SPOF and self-managed; a VPC endpoint only reaches AWS services, not arbitrary repositories.
